title: Couples Dancing at Social Hall, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1950s square snapshot featuring couples dancing at a local community hall or social event. In the center, two women dance together in a warm embrace, one wearing a mid-century polka-dot A-line dress and the other wearing distinctive horn-rimmed glasses. Around them, other couples dance while onlookers rest in folding chairs along the wall beneath fluorescent ceiling fixtures.
